en.headline: Hong Kong airport first in world to use robots for runway painting
en.dek: Airport Authority says machines in use since September cut centreline painting from three hours to one and save HK$400,000 a year in paint.
body: Hong Kong International Airport has become the first in the world to deploy automatic painting robots for runway markings that guide aircraft during take-off, landing and taxiing, the Airport Authority said.

Chief operating officer Steven Yiu said the robots, adapted from sports-field line-marking technology developed with a Shenzhen firm, entered formal use in September after testing and approval by the Civil Aviation Department. Markings across the three runways, spanning more than 11 kilometres, must be repainted regularly; some centre lines need weekly attention because of frequent contact with aircraft.

Yiu said painting a centreline previously took about three hours by hand but now takes one hour with the robot. Precise spray control is expected to save about HK$400,000 in paint each year, while overall working hours for the task fall by roughly two-thirds. Staff continue to handle curves and more complex markings, and the authority plans to deploy a total of six robots.

The machines use real-time kinematic positioning from four global navigation satellite systems to achieve centimetre-level accuracy. Yiu expressed hope that robotic runway painting would eventually become a civil aviation standard.

zh.headline: 香港機場全球首用機械人為跑道噴劃標識
zh.dek: 機管局表示機械人九月起投入使用，中線噴劃由三小時縮至一小時，每年節省油漆開支約四十萬港元。
body: 香港國際機場成為全球首個以自動噴油機械人為跑道標識重新噴劃的機場，協助引導飛機升降及滑行，機管局表示。
機管局首席營運總監姚兆聰指出，有關機械人由球場劃線技術改良而成，與深圳公司合作研發，經測試並獲民航處批准後，已於九月正式投入運作。機場三條跑道總長逾十一公里，各類標識須定期重噴；中線因經常受機輪接觸，甚至需每周保養。
姚兆聰稱，以往人手噴劃一條中線約需三小時，現時機械人只需一小時。精準控制噴量預計每年可節省約四十萬港元油漆開支，相關工序工時整體減少約三分之二。曲線及較複雜標識仍由人手處理，機管局計劃最終配備六部機械人。
機械人採用全球導航衞星系統實時動態定位技術，結合多個衞星系統，定位精準度達一至兩厘米。姚兆聰希望機械人噴劃跑道標識日後能成為民航標準。
